subject.title: improve(mattermost): restart only the changed account on config reload

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `reload.accountScopedRestart` as an opt-in `ChannelPlugin` capability and accept Mattermost as the first channel to claim that isolation contract?
rationale: The patch is mechanically covered and deliberately keeps non-opted-in channels wholesale, but the new plugin API defines a durable cross-plugin safety boundary that automated review cannot choose on behalf of gateway and plugin owners.

options.title: Accept the capability contract
options.body: Approve the documented opt-in boundary, keep Mattermost as the only initial claimant, and require a final current-main merge-result refresh before landing.

options.title: Keep reloads wholesale
options.body: Reject the new public capability and retain existing whole-channel semantics until a broader owner-designed lifecycle API is ready.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Ask for a gateway/plugin-owner revision that moves or reshapes the capability before accepting any channel opt-in.

recommendation.title: Accept the capability contract
recommendation.body: Approve the documented opt-in boundary, keep Mattermost as the only initial claimant, and require a final current-main merge-result refresh before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of the neighboring gateway reload lifecycle surface makes this the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate available.
